Description: The USGS site number, note that many site numbers begin with a leading zero that is dropped by excel.

Date of the peak flow for that water year
The peak flow for that water year in units of cubic feet per second

The phase of the Oceanic Nino Index, values include Cool Phase/La Nina (< 0.5 C), Neutral Phase (-0.5 to 0.5 C), and Warm Phase/El Nino (> 0.5 C).
